name: Swimming, Butterfly
instructions: Begin face down with both arms extended forward. Sweep both arms out and back together in a simultaneous pulling motion while your hips rise and fall in a dolphin-like undulation.
Kick both legs together in a single whip-like motion, timing two kicks per arm cycle. Lift your head and chest to breathe as your arms recover forward over the water.
Butterfly is the most demanding swimming stroke, requiring significant upper body and core strength. A 150 lb person will burn over 450 calories swimming butterfly for 30 minutes.
